sections.h2: What healthcare staff training software does here
paras: Healthcare staff training software teaches a defined skill, checks it with an assessment and records the pass against the person, so a service head or a hospital administrator can say who is trained on which equipment or protocol. Aura Learn does this with a learner mobile app for the staff and an admin dashboard for the person who runs training.

Two groups use it most. Medical-equipment companies certify their service engineers per model before those engineers are sent to install or maintain it. Hospitals, clinics and diagnostic centres train clinical and front-desk staff on operating procedures, new equipment and patient-handling protocols. In both cases lessons work offline, the assessment is graded on submission, a certificate is issued on a pass and compliance tracking shows who is due.

sections.h2: One engineer knows the new model. Everyone else learns on the customer's machine.
sections.lead: Equipment and protocol training usually happens once, at a launch or a factory visit, and then spreads by word of mouth.

items.p: The principal trains two engineers; the rest pick it up on site, in front of the hospital's biomedical team.

items.q: Can we certify engineers per equipment model?
items.a: Yes. Each model has its own course and assessment. An engineer who passes is certified for that model on their record, and the certified list per model can be checked before a dispatch or exported for a customer.

items.q: Does it connect to our field-service system?
items.a: The training record sits in Aura Learn, and the service desk that dispatches engineers can use the certified list alongside job cards. See medical equipment field service software for the dispatch and job-card side.

items.q: Can hospital staff use it on shift?
items.a: Yes. Lessons are short, download to the phone and can be completed offline between duties. Quizzes are taken in the same app, and the department head sees completion per batch or per site.

No. Compliance tracking here records who completed which training and passed which assessment, which supports regulated training records. It does not certify the software or your organisation against any standard.
A programme can carry a renewal period. Staff approaching it are listed as due, assigned the refresher and reminded on WhatsApp, and the new pass replaces the old certificate on the record.

items.q: How many staff can we enrol?
items.a: As many as you have. Aura Learn is built for unlimited learners, so every engineer, nurse, technician and front-desk member across sites can be enrolled without changing what you pay. Scope is agreed on a call.
